test_metaestimator_delegation: test that metaestimators delegate methods to their inner sub-estimators when the sub-estimator has them
test_meta_estimators_delegate_data_valid: test that meta-estimators delegate data validation to inner estimator(s) instead of validating themselves
create_DelegatorData_instance: create a DelegatorData instance to configure metaestimator delegation tests with name, constructor, and skip methods
generate_meta_estimator_instances_with_p: generate instances of meta-estimators wrapped with pipelines for automated testing across all sklearn estimators
get_instance_with_pipeline: wrap a meta-estimator instance with a pipeline using make_pipeline for data validation test cases
